title: sprint-doctor input
description: Required dispatch-context keys for the sprint-doctor role, per agents/sprint-doctor.md Inputs section (design doc section 2.2). The doctor gets zero tools: everything it can see is assembled into this context by the runner BEFORE dispatch. Consumed by callers for pre-dispatch validation only -- never appended to the prompt or shown to the LLM verbatim (the runner renders these fields into the prompt itself).

branch.description: Sprint track branch this consult is diagnosing.

phaseLabel.description: The current phase label the consult interrupted (dashboard-visible).

budget.description: The sprint's own budget accounting; doctor spend flows through it like every other dispatch.

evidence.description: The health-ledger rows that satisfied this trigger.

triggeringBeadIds.description: The bead id(s) involved in the triggering incident.

beadDetails.description: Full `bd show --json` output for each triggering bead, plus scope summary counts (open/in_progress/blocked/deferred/closed at goal priority).

errorSignatureFrequency.description: Cross-member errorSignature frequency table -- the environment-vs-engine triage signal (design doc section 2.2).

dispatchHistory.description: Ledger rows for the triggering bead(s) and member(s), plus per-member aggregate failure counts.

sprintLog.description: Last N KB of the runner's own sprint log (default cap 16KB).

memberDispatchOutput.description: Last N KB of the relevant member-side dispatch output (default cap 16KB).

consultHistory.description: This sprint's own prior doctor verdicts + their outcomes -- required for the no-repeat circuit-breaker (design doc section 6) so the doctor never re-prescribes a failed remedy blind.

registry.description: The symptom/remedy registry (design doc section 4), injected as data, never baked into the prompt text.
